note: Synthetic data only. Phone numbers use 555, emails use exemple.ca / example.com, health insurance numbers are fake. expected=true means the message must be blocked. kinds lists the PII kinds the UI should name. hard=true marks a boundary case. holdout=true marks cases written after the first tuning; their first score is reported, then two filter fixes came from them. holdout=2 marks a second set written after those fixes and scored once, with no change after. Version 3 (2026-10-24): layer=name-intro cases test the deterministic self-introduction and signature layer (regexPii, nameInIntro). A lowercase first name in « moi c'est baptiste » passed the entity model.
